title: Conversation and Speaking Expressions — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: You are happy to lend your dictionary. Which reply to "Would you mind lending me your dictionary?" is kurang tepat?

visual.text: Yes, I would. Here you are.

choices.say: Yes, I would. Here you are.

visual.text: Not at all. Here you are.

choices.say: Not at all. Here you are.

items.reteach: "Would you mind …?" artinya "keberatankah?". "Yes, I would" berarti keberatan, jadi bertentangan dengan "Here you are".

items.prompt: Which expression of congratulation is grammatically correct?
items.reteach: Pola: Congratulations (jamak) + on + V-ing/noun.

items.prompt: Which "How about …" suggestion is correct?

items.prompt: A: "My cat has been sick for three days." Which reply is kurang tepat?

items.prompt: In the mango dialogue, how much does Mrs. Tuti pay in total?

stimulus.text: Seller: These mangoes are sweet, ma'am. Rp25,000 a kilo. Mrs. Tuti: Could you make it Rp20,000? Seller: How about Rp22,000? Mrs. Tuti: Deal. Two kilos, please.

items.reteach: Harga disepakati Rp22,000 per kilo × 2 kilo = Rp44,000.

items.prompt: In the mango dialogue, what does Mrs. Tuti express by saying "Deal."?

stimulus.text: Seller: These mangoes are sweet, ma'am. Rp25,000 a kilo. Mrs. Tuti: Could you make it Rp20,000? Seller: How about Rp22,000? Mrs. Tuti: Deal. Two kilos, please.

items.reteach: "Deal" = setuju/sepakat dengan tawaran.
